profile.historySummary: The university grew out of the Calabar campus of the University of Nigeria, Nsukka, which began operating in the 1973/1974 academic session. The Federal Military Government announced in April 1975 that the Calabar campus would become a full university. UNICAL states that its academic journey as a full university began in October 1976.
profile.mission: To produce high-quality graduates and scholars in a conducive learning environment through teaching, research and community service, responsive to societal and global needs.
profile.vision: To be a centre of excellence in teaching, research and community service, producing well-rounded graduates equipped to contribute to national and global development.

steps: Open the official UNICAL student portal.
New undergraduate candidates: buy the status PIN through the portal, then check admission with the JAMB registration number and PIN.
After an offer is confirmed, follow the portal's account-creation and acceptance instructions.
Returning students: activate using the matriculation number or JAMB number and surname, then set the email address and password.
Already activated students: sign in with the matriculation/JAMB number and password.
For activation or payment problems, use the portal Help page and the official university contact channels.
Open the official Post-UTME/Direct Entry portal.
Select the correct admission route and follow the session-specific notice.
Use only the official portal for application and payment instructions.
For any payment or document issue, contact the university through its published official contact channel.

institutions.canonicalName: Federal University of Health Sciences, Ila Orangun

profile.overview: A specialised federal university focused on health sciences, medical and allied health education, biomedical research and patient-centred healthcare services.
profile.vision: To be a world-class institution of academic excellence in health sciences, producing medical and healthcare professionals of international repute.
profile.mission: To provide outstanding health sciences education, foster innovative biomedical research and deliver patient-centred healthcare services through collaboration, technology and ethical practice.

academicUnits.note: These are academic groupings in the official navigation; confirm official faculty/college nomenclature before publishing as faculties.

notes: For MBBS and Nursing Science, the page specifies at least a Second Class Upper degree in a relevant biological science course OR high A-Level/JUPEB/IJMB grades in Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
Registered Nurse / Registered Midwife qualifications are also accepted for Nursing Science.
For other programmes, the page describes A-Level passes in relevant science subjects or at least an Upper Credit ND in a related science discipline.
Map the exact qualification-to-programme requirements before presenting eligibility as final.

aggregateCutoffs.note: These are 2026/2027 approved programme aggregate cut-offs on a 0-100 scale. The page's separate screening formula section is labeled 2025/2026; do not infer the 2026/2027 calculation formula from it.

aggregateFormula.note: The same official admissions page contains a separate 2025/2026 screening-formula section. Do not apply that older formula to the 2026/2027 departmental cut-off table unless FUHSI publishes a 2026/2027 formula or confirms that it remains unchanged.

admission.newProgrammeRequirementsStatus: Not included in the verified 2026/2027 programme table in the current official page snapshot; do not show until the university confirms the exact programmes and combinations.

legacyFormulaReference.note: The admissions page explicitly labels this formula 2025/2026; it is preserved only as a historical page statement and must not be used as a 2026/2027 benchmark.

steps: Open the official admissions portal.
Check the programme-specific UTME minimum and subject combination before applying.
Confirm FUHSI is selected as first choice, or complete the change-of-institution process when required.
Choose Post-UTME Registration and enter the UTME registration number.
Generate the official screening invoice and pay through the portal's stated payment route.
Complete biodata and O'Level result details.
Submit the application and save/print the screening slip.
portalGuides.stageNote: The page's older/how-to-apply section mentions later physical verification. The September 16, 2026 online-clearance notice says post-offer clearance is 100% online at that stage. Keep the two stages separate.

steps: Open the official FUHSI portal and sign in using the account credentials created during application.
Check admission or clearance status in the portal.
Upload clear copies of the documents requested by the portal and current official notice.
When the status is CLEARED, generate the school-fees invoice and pay only through the official portal's approved payment process.
Save official receipts and clearance documents.
requiredDocumentsMentioned: O'Level certificate or statement of result
Birth certificate or statutory declaration of age
Evidence of acceptance-fee and medical-fee payments

profile.historySummary: The university states that its present federal status as the University of Uyo dates to 1991, when the Federal Government took over the University of Cross River State in Uyo; academic activities as the University of Uyo commenced in the 1991/1992 session. The official history page gives different predecessor dates in separate passages (1981 and 1983), so this earlier chronology is retained as an unresolved source discrepancy rather than collapsed into one date.

profile.vision: To be a centre of academic excellence by utilizing the available human and technological resources for teaching, research, community service and sustainable development.

steps: Open the official UNIUYO admissions portal.
Select Apply Now.
First-time applicants should create an account and verify the email address to activate it.
Open the Application Fee section and select the correct application type: Post-UTME or Direct Entry.
Generate the Remita Retrieval Reference (RRR), pay through the stated Remita route, then return to the portal to confirm payment.
Complete the application form and upload the required documents in PDF format.
Submit the completed application and print the 2026/2027 Screening Exercise Slip.
Open the official UNIUYO ePortals Hub.
Choose Student's Portal - NEW for the newer student portal, or use the legacy option only when specifically instructed by the university.
Use the credentials and instructions issued by the university; EduReach should never request or store a student's portal password or one-time code.

knownGaps: The Chancellor page is an official listing but provides an appointment date in 2015; current term or reappointment needs confirmation.
The full current faculty, school, department and programme hierarchy has not yet been completely reconciled.
No programme-specific 2026/2027 UTME cut-offs were collected.

Campus names are published, but campus addresses and programme-to-campus assignments remain unresearched.

The official institutional history page contains inconsistent predecessor dates (1981 and 1983); the 1991 federal conversion and 1991/1992 academic commencement are the facts used for the current institution profile.

nationalAdmissionPolicy.notes: National tolerable minimums only. Institutions and programmes may publish higher eligibility thresholds. These figures are not departmental cut-offs, do not guarantee admission, and must not override programme-specific JAMB IBASS eligibility.
